title: Koh Samui Villas with Infinity Pools: What to Look For and Where to Find Them
description: Find the best Koh Samui villas with infinity pools and private plunge pools. Learn what makes a great pool villa and where on the island the views are finest.

blocks.text: A Koh Samui villa with an infinity pool and an unobstructed sea view is one of the most singular travel experiences available anywhere in the world. The combination of warm water, the Gulf of Thailand stretching to the horizon, and a sunrise that builds slowly from deep purple to brilliant gold is something most people see once and spend years trying to recreate. Here’s what to know before you book.
Infinity Pool vs. Plunge Pool vs. Standard Pool
The terms are used interchangeably in villa listings, but they describe very different experiences:

items: Infinity pool — a full-size swimming pool with one or more vanishing edges that create the illusion of the water extending to the horizon. Usually 8-15 metres long. Ideal for swimming laps and groups.

Plunge pool — a smaller, deeper pool (typically 3-5 metres) designed for cooling off rather than swimming. Often more intimate and set directly off the bedroom terrace. Some have jet systems for hydrotherapy.
Jet plunge pool — a plunge pool with a pressurised water jet system, functioning as both a pool and a jacuzzi. The most versatile option for couples or small groups.
Jacuzzi/hot tub — a separate feature from the pool, with heated water and bubble jets. Some villas include both a pool and a separate jacuzzi.

blocks.text: Why the View Matters as Much as the Pool

An infinity pool facing a garden is pleasant. An infinity pool or plunge pool with a direct sea view facing the Gulf of Thailand at sunrise changes the nature of the experience entirely. The engineering of an infinity pool is specifically designed to create a visual connection between the water’s surface and the horizon — and that effect only works fully when the horizon is actually the sea.

For this reason, hillside villas in elevated positions on the north and east of the island — particularly the Plai Laem and Choeng Mon area — offer the most dramatic pool and view combinations. The sunrise from these east-facing positions is extraordinary.
What to Check Before Booking a Pool Villa

items: Pool is private to your unit — confirm in writing that the pool is not shared with other villas or guests
View direction — east-facing for sunrise (Gulf of Thailand), west-facing for sunset
Pool dimensions — request actual measurements if size matters to you
Heating availability — Koh Samui’s water is warm year-round, but some guests prefer heated pools. Check if this is included or an add-on cost.
Pool maintenance schedule — confirm when the pool is cleaned and serviced (typically early morning, so it’s ready by the time you wake)
Night lighting — illuminated pools after dark are beautiful. Ask whether the pool has underwater lighting.

blocks.text: The Best Pool Times of Day
Koh Samui’s pool experience changes throughout the day:

items: 5:30-6:30 am — the sunrise swim. The light is spectacular and the air is still cool.
7-9 am — breakfast by the pool, before the sun reaches full intensity.
12-2 pm — the hottest part of the day. A plunge pool provides instant relief.
5-7 pm — the golden hour pool swim. Light turns warm and horizontal.
After dark — an illuminated pool on a clear night, with stars overhead and the lights of distant islands visible on the horizon, is one of Koh Samui’s finest simple pleasures.

blocks.text: Many hillside villas in the Plai Laem area include rooftop jacuzzis or terrace-mounted hot tubs with sea views. The experience of a jacuzzi at sunrise, looking out over the Gulf with a coffee or a fruit shake, is one of those quietly extraordinary moments that define a great villa stay.
